images.title: Humans — neutral body and face studies
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original Breachline high-fantasy production character reference sheet, landscape 1536x1024. Traditional oil/acrylic/gouache painted realism with confident economical brushwork, broad colour planes and selective crisp anatomy. NOT photography, glossy 3D, anime, cartoon, or hyperreal microtexture.
BACKGROUND AND LIGHT: entirely flat warm off-white background, uniform soft neutral daylight, no scenery, floor plane, gradient, cast shadows, stage, atmospheric fog, rim light, props or coloured light. Crisp isolated complete silhouettes with generous white space. This is deliberately a neutral design sheet, NOT a scene or card illustration.
LAYOUT: upper two thirds contain exactly THREE full-body views of ONE SAME adult individual, left FRONT, middle TRUE SIDE PROFILE facing left, right REAR. Same body, hair, garments, proportions and height in all three views. Relaxed standing, feet apart, hands open held a little away from torso; all fingers, feet and top of head visible, no overlapping limbs. No action. Lower third contains exactly SIX evenly spaced head-and-neck portraits of SIX DIFFERENT adults of this same species, facing varied slight three-quarter angles. The first head matches the turnaround subject; five alternate castings thereafter. All complete heads with space around them. No borders, labels, numbers, lettering, signatures, watermark or card UI.
CLOTHING: unless specified otherwise, plain undyed oatmeal linen long-sleeve pullover tunic, dull brown straight trousers, simple plain soft leather shoes, simple cloth belt. Opaque ordinary practical unisex clothes, modest fit, no ornaments, armor, weapons, jewelry, emblems, capes, goldmark, profession or faction cues.
FACE DIRECTION: distinguish identities through skull length/width, brow, eyelid shape, nose bridge and tip, mouth and jaw, age and hairline, NOT merely hairstyle, dirt, scars or skin colour. Subtle real asymmetry and natural resting expressions; varied conventional attractiveness, generally appealing but mostly everyday believable faces with just ONE unusually beautiful or striking individual. Avoid six polished fashion models, identical triangular jaws, sculpted lips, seductive gazes or symmetrical beauty filters. Older people need not be unattractive; young people need not be beautiful. Simplify skin/fur/bark into painted forms, no etched pores, bulging shiny eyes or individually highlighted teeth. All figures are adults. An invented fantasy race does not have a universal faction.
SPECIES AND SPECIFIC CAST:
HUMANS. Turnaround: an ordinary adult woman in her early thirties, average sturdy build and height, olive complexion, short roughly cut dark brown hair, longer nose with a slight bridge bump, broad mouth, slightly uneven brows, calm attentive expression; pleasant but not a model. Six portrait castings from left to right: (1) same woman; (2) a young adult man about 23 with a soft round jaw, wide-set eyes, broad short nose and slightly prominent ears, naturally appealing but unglamorous; (3) a lean man about 52 with a long narrow face, receding hairline, crooked aquiline nose and compressed mouth; (4) a woman about 62 with a strong broad face, deep brown skin, rounded nose, warm eyes and short silver curls, dignified and handsome; (5) an adult woman about 28 who is unusually beautiful but specific, dark straight hair, pronounced nose, slightly uneven smile, no cosmetics or sexualized pose; (6) a broad-faced adult man about 38, medium brown skin, close textured hair, heavy brow, small eyes and soft chin. Range of human backgrounds across this casting sheet is not a single mixed settlement. Keep everyone equally well painted and dressed.

REFERENCE POLICY: Reference image 1 belongs to LEFT column, image 2 to CENTRE, image 3 to RIGHT. Extract ONLY the specified garment and equipment forms. Do not import their pose, face, skin, environment, action, atmosphere or background. Where a source obscures part of an object, reconstruct the unseen part simply and coherently. Do not invent large decorative mechanisms or new faction badges. Specific new accessory proposals are allowed only as listed below.
COLUMN CONTENT:
LEFT COLUMN, reference 1 ASHEN COURT NOBLE. Top: her tailored ash-grey and muted plum cloth overgown, sober fitted bodice, long broad sleeves and skirt, recognizably the same elegant cut with a few restrained silver-grey embroidered stem shapes at the upper chest; do not reproduce every embroidered detail or invent metal armor. Empty neck and cuffs, no torso. Middle: ONE small refined court dagger with narrow plain blade, modest straight guard, dark plum leather grip and undecorated silver pommel, sheath beside it; this is a NEW restrained possible sidearm, not visible in the portrait and not a faction standard. Bottom: her pair of long grey cloth gloves, natural fingers, small wrist seam, no rings or armor.
CENTRE COLUMN, reference 2 ASHEN COURT BAILIFF. Top: his workaday charcoal-grey knee-length coat with a single brown leather shoulder yoke and modest padded collar, rolled cuffs showing muted violet lining. Straightforward tailoring, plain belt, minimal protection; no elite black lamellar harness, skulls or giant high collar. Middle: the plain turned dark wood baton carried at his belt, stout practical grip and rounded head, exact modest scale and style of the source. Bottom: a ring of THREE practical old iron keys, distinct plausible bits and simple bows, no giant magical key, words or heraldic symbols.
RIGHT COLUMN, reference 3 BONE HARVESTER. Top: his worn hooded grey-violet cloth robe, one continuous robe and modest shoulder mantle, softly frayed edges, still a comprehensible sewn garment, not thirty floating scraps. Sparse faded hem edging from reference, no invented armor or antlers. Middle: his short-handled iron sickle, complete curved blade with a plain dark wood grip, restrained old metal. Bottom: his EMPTY rectangular woven carrying basket, two simple leather shoulder straps visible, no contents, bones or human remains.
Visual variety matters: refined cloth, utilitarian working coat, and weathered ritual/labor clothing, all from individual source characters. A dark military kit can exist elsewhere but must not constrain these roles. No uniform matching black steel, compulsory skull emblems, purple glow, gothic props, dramatic candlelight or background scenes.
images.visual_review: Reviewed: nine clear design groups, three character columns, no bodies or scenery; simpler construction and distinct source-based roles.

reference_usage_guidance.purpose: Initial design references that support continued invention, not a closed catalog.
reference_usage_guidance.new_characters: Create new faces, builds, outfits, armor and weapons beyond these sheets while retaining species-defining anatomy, art direction and setting coherence.
reference_usage_guidance.exact_reuse: Reserve identity and signature-item matching for the same established character or an explicit reuse request; do not require it for new characters.
reference_usage_guidance.variation: Vary silhouette, cut, proportion, materials, craft, condition, role and taste; review against recent art for repeated faces and kit. Recoloring and small accessories alone are insufficient.
reference_usage_guidance.construction: Keep construction coherent and purposeful. Variety need not add layers, straps or ornament.
reference_usage_guidance.scope: No sample defines an entire people or faction. Historical prompts record sheet generation and do not limit future art.
